title: Shield response
body:
I've been working on the shield visuals for Conventional Space Fleet. Incoming rounds send ripples across the curved surface, with overlapping waves and a faint hexagonal lattice around the ship.

This short showcase cycles through Ion blue, Violet and Amber, with slow camera moves to show how the field catches each impact.

videos.caption: Ion blue, Violet and Amber shield palettes around the Kestrel, with incoming rounds and expanding surface ripples.
